blocks.text: MANOLO FORTICH, Bukidnon — Malacañang on Thursday dismissed speculations regarding potential replacements for Vice President Sara Duterte, saying “it is premature to discuss her successor” while the impeachment trial is still ongoing. Speaking at a press briefing at the Northern Bukidnon State College (NBSC) here, during the Presidential Communications Office’s (PCO) “Usap Tayo, Bayan Muna” forum, PCO Undersecretary Claire Castro told reporters that no discussions have taken place regarding possible replacements, including names floated in public such as Senator Miguel Zubiri.
